hook: A Riemann claim, a $1T chip idea and a data center threat
open: Tonight, a claimed Riemann proof, SoftBank's look at SK Hynix, and Trump on data centers abroad.

stories.headline: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved Riemann hypothesis with Claude
stories.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge published a claim that he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, a 167-year-old open mathematical problem. The solution has not yet been independently verified by experts or accepted by the Clay Mathematics Institute.
stories.why_it_matters: If verified by the mathematics community, it would represent a major milestone for AI in solving long-standing open problems in number theory.

stories.headline: SoftBank explored a $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix
stories.summary: SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son explored financing for a potential $1 trillion buyout of memory chip giant SK Hynix. SoftBank stated that the deal is no longer under active consideration.
stories.why_it_matters: It highlights major investment and capital exploration by SoftBank within the semiconductor supply chain that underpins artificial intelligence hardware.

stories.headline: Thinking Machines Lab releases Inkling 2 Mini open-weights model
stories.summary: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B-parameter open-weights Mixture-of-Experts transformer that loops its middle layers three times per token. The ~20GB model is small enough to run on consumer laptops and leads open-weights models under 100B parameters on benchmarks like DeepSWE v1.1.
stories.why_it_matters: The release demonstrates the practical application of looped transformer architectures in sub-100B parameter models designed for local hardware execution.
source_titles: TML releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 26.4B-parameter transformer that loops middle layers three times per token for better reasoning with fewer tokens (Thinking Machines Lab)

stories.headline: Cognition AI in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation
stories.summary: Cognition AI Inc. is in funding talks to raise $2 billion or more at a $75 billion valuation. The startup has raised over $3 billion in 2026 so far, including $2 billion at a $48 billion valuation in September.
stories.why_it_matters: This move highlights the rapid escalation of valuations and funding activity for artificial intelligence coding startups in 2026.

stories.headline: Trump threatens tax and ban on US companies building data centers overseas
stories.summary: President Donald Trump stated that U.S. companies will be blocked from building data centers overseas or face a heavy tax. Major cloud providers including Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Oracle have already built data centers in other countries.
stories.why_it_matters: The proposal addresses the geopolitical and energy constraints of the AI boom, forcing a clash between domestic infrastructure policy and the global expansion strategies of major tech companies.
source_titles: Trump says he would block US companies from building data centers overseas or impose a "tremendous tax" on them if they do (Julianna Bragg/Axios)
